name: Ardalan Kahak
title: R&D Engineer, Research Scientist, Mechanical Engineer.
tagline: Working on programmable interfaces for applications in acoustics, physical reservoir computing, and wearable technologies. Seeking opportunities in advanced mechanical engineering, electromechanical systems, soft robotics, and wearable devices.
about: Mechanical Engineering Ph.D. candidate at Virginia Tech specializing in electromechanical system design, soft robotics, and prototype development. My work spans programmable acoustic holograms, inflatable Kirigami interfaces, soft piezoelectric  reservoir-computing patches, and haptic interfaces, with hands-on experience in embedded electronics, sensor integration, fabrication, and control systems. I also bring industry experience in large-scale automation and manufacturing. I am seeking advanced R&D, soft robotics, or wearable electronics roles where cross-disciplinary engineering and hands-on fabrication can drive innovative product development.

experience.summary: Advancing 2D design and geometry-driven principles, such as Kirigami, to develop integrated sensors and mechanical computing systems.

Contributed to the design, fabrication, installation, and troubleshooting of stage machinery projects as a member of the manufacturing team. Gained hands-on experience coordinating with external vendors, preparing BOMs, supporting prototype manufacturing, and collaborating within a team.
